test_scenarios.name: Happy Path: create task
test_scenarios.description: Normal successful flow with valid inputs

test_steps.details: Prepare valid test data meeting all preconditions
Login with appropriate role and permissions
Perform the main action with valid inputs
Check that all expected outcomes are achieved

Task appears in project task list
postconditions: Notification sent to assignee if specified
